alerts.summary: Hypoperfusion before adequate fluid — assess fluid resuscitation
alerts.clinical_reasoning: Lactate 3.5 mmol/L with MAP 60.0 mmHg, but < 30 mL/kg crystalloid given in the last 3 h. This may be under-resuscitation, not shock — the distinction changes the next action (volume vs pressors).
recommended_actions: Assess fluid responsiveness before escalating vasopressors.
Consider continuing crystalloid toward 30 mL/kg if not contraindicated.
Monitor lactate and MAP after the next fluid bolus.
alerts.confidence: Fluid target: conditional recommendation, low certainty (SSC 2026).
